verdict.rationale: The GST portal home page has an 'Upcoming Due Dates' section with a downloadable PDF, so filing deadlines appear to be published. Nothing in the pack shows the late fee, penalty or interest schedule, or any exact figures. missing for 10: a published late-fee/penalty schedule with exact amounts, interest rates for late payment or filing, evidence that the due-dates PDF gives exact dates per return type, independent corroboration.
